text: 1.Between 18 and 25 years old, in good health.2. Complete high school or equivalent courses, with all subjects on the transcript required to be passed or above. Students who have not obtained a high school diploma must submit a pre-graduation certificate.3. Chinese proficiency requirements for Chinese-taught majors:All majors in the School of Humanities require a score of 180 or above in HSK Level 4 or a one-year study of Chinese at our school and passing the exam.4. Professional English proficiency requirements for English-taught programs:Toefl 80 or above; Ielts 6.0 or above; Duolingo score 100 or above; Or equivalent English proficiency certificates, such as EF.5. If the previous learning stage was taught in Chinese or English, proof of the corresponding language of instruction can be submitted, and the language proficiency certificate is exempted.
